name: dsh-eyes-upload
description: DSH plugin: invisible image upload for text-only models. Adds a 传图 button + Ctrl+V paste to the composer; images are saved and analyzed with deepseek-eyes (Qwen-VL via ModelScope), and the analysis is injected into the user's next message at the model pre-step — no popups, no draft writes. Ships the deepseek-eyes skill globally.
